title: Peeping
text: “Come to think of it, Father, what’s your level now?”

“I’m at Level 38. I used quite a few enhancement materials to upgrade my shield, too. I also did that ‘Weapon Copy’ thing you taught me earlier before coming to this inn, so I think I’ve gotten pretty strong, don’t you think?”

We’re chatting while taking off our clothes. Hmm… Your physique, Father—you’ve put on just a bit more muscle than I remember from the last time before the loop. Since you were close to Level 100 back then, I suppose that’s only natural.

“I’ve also learned quite a few new Skills, so I’m somewhat stronger, right? Still, it’s a bit scary that I can’t really gauge just how much stronger I’ve become. I don’t have any real combat experience, after all.”
“You’re too modest—you’re always so reliable, Father.”
“Hmm… To be honest, I’m a little anxious. There’s a risk of being all talk and no action—just having a high level but being useless in actual combat. I’ve played online games before, you know.”
“I believe you used to be the master of a famous guild, didn’t you?”
“Ah, so that’s what people are talking about in the future?　Yeah, I’m part of the leadership of a major guild—we’re ranked around third on the server.”
“That’s right.”

“But what does that have to do with anything? Well, I guess I did learn how to set up formations, give simple orders like ‘charge’ or ‘retreat,’ and provide rear support, but I really don’t think that’ll be useful now that I’m in another world.”
“What are you saying? Based on your experience, Father accomplished the great feat of minimizing casualties.”

Back when I was still foolish, unlike the rest of us—who focused solely on attacking the Wave Boss and the Rift without considering the damage to those around us—my father seemed to be thinking about how to minimize casualties. Thanks to that, the casualties were likely kept low. I’ve heard that my father commanded soldiers who volunteered to fight in enemy territory—Melromarc—and minimized casualties there.

He must have continued to apply his guild battle experience in various battles after that as well. I’m well aware that I, Motoyasu, was able to bring out my full potential by following Father’s instructions. So I’m sure he’ll demonstrate his outstanding talent once again this time.
“Hmm… Something just feels off. I find Motoyasu’s testimony a bit suspicious… Was I really the one in command? Did I maybe delegate it to someone else?”
Father is quite the skeptic. I remember this level of scrutiny all too well.
“There’s no doubt about it.”
“Well, if Motoyasu-kun says so, I’ll believe it… but I don’t think this kind of thing would work on a specialist. I wonder if what I picked up from video games will actually be useful…”
“Kitamura, let’s wash each other’s backs!”
“Yes, yes. Got it.”

Since Kou begged me to wash him, I started washing his back. I carefully lathered up the base of his wings with soapy water to wash away the dirt. It’s this kind of meticulous work that contributes to Filolial-sama’s beauty. Unfortunately, I usually only do this for the males, Midori and Kou, but I used to handle the grooming for Kuu, Marin, and the others after they got out of the bath.
“Ticklish!”
“Now, now, you have to stay still.”
“Okay! Iwatani, let’s wash each other’s backs too!”
“Yeah, let’s do that.”
Just as we were happily washing each other’s backs, Sakura-chan climbed over the hedge in her Filolial Queen form.
“Wait! Sakura! That’s the men’s bath!”
I could hear Éclair’s voice.
“Naofumi!”
“Ah, Sakura-chan… you came after all.”
“Let’s take a bath together!”
“Ah, okay, okay. Éclair-san, Sakura-chan has come over—what should we do?”
Father called out to Éclair. Then, Éclair let out a troubled-sounding voice as she seemed to be scolding Yuki-chan.
“Why am I the only one who isn’t allowed to go over to Motoyasu-sama?”
“No means no! Sakura, Lord Iwatani will scold you, and you’ll be back in a flash.”
“I also wish to take a bath with Lord Motoyasu.”
Hearing this exchange, my Father steps in to calm Sakura-chan down.
“That’s exactly why you need to hurry back to the women’s bath.”
“Ehh… Then let’s go to the women’s bath too, Naofumi!”
“Huh!? Wait, wait a minute!”
Sakura-chan hoisted her Father onto her back and dashed off into the women’s bath.
“I-Iwatani-sama! Why are you in the women’s bath?!”
“It’s not my fault! Sakura-chan just decided to carry me over here on her own.”
“Yeah. Sakura, I want to take a hot spring bath with Naofumi.”
“No way! Hurry up and take Iwatani-sama back to the men’s bath!”
“Boo…”
“Mr. Iwatani, since you’re desperately covering your eyes with your hands this time, I’ll let it slide—but be careful in the future.”
“I-I know, I know.”
Right away, Sakura-chan hopped over the hedge and brought her Father back. Father—he’s truly something else. I wonder what state Yuki was in.
“I’m not done talking yet!”
Yuki-chan is still protesting to Éclair. Even so, Yuki-chan’s voice really carries, doesn’t it?
“Yuki-chan, I’ll be going to peek into the women’s bath in a little while.”
“Kitamura-sama!”
It seems Éclair is muttering some kind of complaint. But I don’t know about that.
“A girl’s charm increases when she’s being watched. That effect diminishes in an open setting, so I’m looking forward to it—”
“…I understand! I’ll wash up and wait so that Lord Motoyasu can see me! …And once he’s seen me, I guarantee my charm will be higher than everyone else’s.”
“W-wait, are you just going to accept that and back down, Yuki…?”
Éclair’s voice has gotten quieter. Sakura-chan was also scolded by her Father and reluctantly went home.
“Hmph. Since Sakura showed her naked body, the effect of her rising charm has been reduced. If she’s learned her lesson from this, she mustn’t go to the men’s bath anymore.”
“Eh? But Sakura is Sakura, so it’s better for her to take a bath with Naofumi and Motoyasu…”
“I don’t know what you’re talking about… Anyway, both of you, wash yourselves properly first, then soak up to your shoulders in the tub.”
“Okay!”

And with that, it seems Yuki-chan and the others quietly began washing themselves. A few minutes later, while worrying about my Father—who had turned slightly red—I turned my attention to the women’s bath.
“So cozy… such a nice bath… bubbling…”
“Sakura, you mustn’t fall asleep in the tub!”
I heard a “plop” sound.
“Zzz…”
“Just because you’re in that position doesn’t mean you’ll figure out some clever way to avoid drowning!”
Eclair is acting like a nagging mother-in-law. It somehow reminds me of my sister-in-law. I wonder what she’s up to right now.
“Ah, Eclair must be having a tough time too…”
“Well, it’s about time to take a peek.”
“Motoyasu, are you seriously going to peek?”
“Of course I am. It’s a promise I made to Yuki-chan, after all.”
“I know you’re not the type to stop just because someone tells you to, Motoyasu, but I really think you should skip this… Yuki-chan would probably be satisfied just knowing you looked.”
“Father, you shouldn’t lie.”
“Well, even so, I still think it’s a bit strange to justify peeping just because of that…”
“Come on, Kou, be my step.”
“What happens if I’m your step?”
“I’ll stroke your cheek.”
“Then I’ll be your stepping stool, Kou!”
“You can’t do that!”
Even though my Father warned him, Kou obeyed my request, transformed into his Filolial King form, and let me climb onto his back.
“There you go, Father, you can watch too.”

Come to think of it, I don’t recall ever peeking into the women’s bath—that paradise—with my Father before. Basically, my father hated women. I suppose that’s why there are slight differences depending on the loop.
“Whoa! S-stop—”
Kou took my words to heart, grabbed my father by the torso, and lifted him up. Now we can see over the fence into the women’s bath. Just then, Éclair popped her head out.
“Mr. Kitamura… I’d like you to uphold public order and morals. Do you have any idea how the women being spied on by you, Lord Kitamura, feel?”
“It’s no problem at all. I, Motoyasu, have never been looked down upon for peeking into the women’s bath.”
“…Sigh. It’s true—if Lord Kitamura just kept quiet, he’s actually quite handsome… Perhaps few women would feel uncomfortable being seen by him. But that’s a completely different matter!”
“Eclair! I’m sorry! I wasn’t looking!”

It seems my Father is covering his eyes with both hands again. What a shy sight—that’s no way for a man to carry himself. A woman’s charm increases when she’s looked at, and a man hones his masculinity by looking.
